changes.reason: Adds the existing inexpensive EC2 parser and navigation unit files to a Node command within the existing static checks job. No new job, branch gate, browser harness, privilege, or deployment.
Documents selecting an EC2 row to inspect its saved security-group IDs and tag values and keeps the read-only limitation explicit.

Deterministic combined bundle. The catalog reply ownership, existing VPC submission flow and SimpleDB bounded request/acknowledgment paths are preserved. The EC2 delta displays records already accepted by the unchanged scoped DescribeInstances request path; only synchronous formatting/filter exclusion of newly displayed collections changes.

models.limits: Existing finite catalog-view reply acceptance and VPC form subgraph analogues only: current/mounted responses, one submission, and reloading after acknowledged outputs. No registered EC2 selection model; not a proof of this EC2 parsing/display, DOM focus, administrator admission, native CloudFormation/VM/network behavior, or JavaScript refinement.

Symbolic local capability, React view ownership, native acknowledgements and publication only. No Go/JavaScript refinement, DOM focus, CSS/reflow, XML parsing or HTTP decoding, native IAM, transaction/SQLite proof, actual cancellation of server writes, or complete SimpleDB semantics.

changes.reason: Reproducible console asset digests; does not implement request dispatch or resource lifecycle.
Generated esbuild input and output provenance for the console projection; unchanged locked dependency versions.
Renders only the selected instance's already-parsed security-group IDs and tag text. No requests, persistence, authorization, or VM control.

Synchronous projection of existing selected-instance metadata. Filter searches existing scalar columns, not new collections. Existing mount/epoch, session binding and all prospective VPC permissions, forms and request/response behavior stay intact.
Bounds and decodes security-group IDs and tags from the existing EC2 XML response in the console. It changes no protocol, network admission, ownership, or server-side resource state.
Node-only console regression suite within the presentation tree: binds exact selected-instance metadata shape, bounds and malformed input refusals. No production behavior.
